name: Saurid Autocracy
description: The mightiest state on Muraganda, a kingdom of saurids and their human subjects in the south.

timeline.summary: Avishkari advance teams deploy and find the treaties secured with the Saurid Autocracy were not signed with the full knowledge of other inhabitants.
timeline.quote: Advance teams from Avishkar were deployed to Muraganda a year before the beginning of the race

timeline.summary: The race crosses Amonkhet and Muraganda, where racers are hindered by giant dinosaurs and Saurid raiders, before returning to Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: Their progress was also hindered by attacks from giant dinosaur and Saurid raiders.
